London failed twice with 'Internal SE Server Error (40101)' and was not retried further; no UK data. Competitor pages were NOT scraped (search snippets only), so word_count, h2s, faqs, schema and image counts are unknown and recorded as 0 or empty. DataForSEO returns organic URLs as google.com/goto redirect links; the real domain is taken from the breadcrumb. Volumes (kw_data_google_ads_search_volume, Australia): best destination wedding locations 30 a month (competition LOW, CPC 2.62); best value luxury, best value luxury destination wedding, affordable luxury destination wedding and luxury destination wedding cost all returned NO volume data (below Google Ads threshold or no data). Zoho task WC3-T567 cites 'US 450 a month' for the primary keyword; that figure was not verified here.

cross_market_insights: The AU SERP is weak and fragmented: video, Pinterest pins, a quote form, forum threads and old roundups (2018, 2022, 2023). No page ranks destinations by luxury value with a stated method.

Intent is mixed: 'cheapest' lists, resort and venue inspiration, and forum budget questions (Reddit 'best location and venue on 60k budget'). Nobody serves the AUD 150K+ couple asking where luxury money goes furthest.
No result in Sydney, Melbourne or Brisbane shows transparent criteria (currency, year, guest count) for any figure. That is the gap to win.
Related searches in all three AU cities: 'best value luxury destination wedding cost' and 'best value luxury destination wedding packages'. Cover both as secondary phrasing.
PAA leans to Australian cost context ('What does an average wedding cost in Australia?') and seasonality ('rarest month'), supporting a season and lead-time section.
Search volume is very low or unmeasured in AU for every requested term except 'best destination wedding locations' (30 a month). Treat this as a cluster and conversion piece, not a traffic play.
payload.recommended_angle: A transparently ranked list of 5 to 7 destinations where a luxury budget buys the most, using only figures our own cost guides publish (quoted as worded, with currency, year and guest count, no conversions), what that budget buys at each, season and lead time where sourced, and who each suits; plus the invisible costs a Wedded Advisor manages that change the real value.
